sub_graphs.title: Consensus Specs Release Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions of a consensus specification release from version bump through publication and client adoption.

nodes.label: VERSION.txt Updated
nodes.description: The VERSION.txt file has been updated with a new version identifier in a merged PR

nodes.label: Trigger GitHub Release Workflow
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow is triggered to create a tagged release from VERSION.txt

nodes.label: Git Tag Created
nodes.description: A git tag matching the version has been created in the repository

nodes.label: Draft Release Created
nodes.description: GitHub draft release auto-generated by the workflow (can take up to 24 hours)

nodes.label: Publish Release
nodes.description: Maintainer manually publishes the draft release on GitHub

nodes.label: Release Published
nodes.description: The release is publicly available on GitHub with reference tests

nodes.label: Notify Client Developers
nodes.description: Announcement posted to Discord channel notifying client developers of new release

nodes.label: Client Developers Notified
nodes.description: Client teams have been informed and can begin incorporating new reference tests

edges.label: Workflow creates git tag from VERSION.txt
Workflow generates draft release with test artifacts

external_entities.name: Spec Maintainer
external_entities.description: Repository maintainer who merges version bump PRs and publishes releases

sub_graphs.title: Consensus Specs Release Failure Recovery
sub_graphs.description: Models the error recovery process when the release workflow fails, including tag cleanup and re-execution.

nodes.label: Release Workflow Failed
nodes.description: The GitHub Actions release workflow has failed during execution

nodes.label: Delete Git Tag
nodes.description: Maintainer deletes the git tag that was created before the failure

nodes.label: Delete Draft Release
nodes.description: Maintainer deletes the incomplete draft release from GitHub

nodes.label: Fix Underlying Issue
nodes.description: Maintainer identifies and fixes the root cause of the workflow failure

nodes.label: Re-run Release Workflow
nodes.description: Maintainer triggers the workflow again after cleanup

nodes.label: Tag Already Exists Error
nodes.description: The workflow fails because a git tag with the same version already exists

edges.label: Workflow fails if tag not deleted first

ambiguities.text: The release workflow 'can take up to 24 hours' without specifying what determines the duration.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume duration depends on reference test generation and artifact compilation. The 24-hour upper bound is a practical observation, not a hard limit.

implicit_assumptions.description: Repository maintainers who merge VERSION.txt changes and publish releases are trusted to not introduce malicious specification changes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised maintainer could publish specifications with subtle security flaws that client teams would implement, affecting the entire network.

implicit_assumptions.description: GitHub Actions infrastructure is available and uncompromised for workflow execution.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised CI could inject malicious reference tests, leading client implementations to adopt incorrect behavior.
